name: Lens Distortion (Image)
mechanism: Analyzes lens distortion (image) patterns to detect AI-generated content. Detects barrel/pincushion lens distortion patterns
parameters: Analysis type: sensor, Media: image, Confidence threshold: adaptive
accuracy: Moderate to High — 65-85% standalone, higher when combined with other methods
source: Research-based sensor analysis method for image forensics
useCase: Detection of AI-generated image through lens distortion (image) analysis
strengths:
• Effective sensor analysis technique
• Works well as complementary method
• Applicable to various image types
• Based on established research
limitations:
• May require sufficient image quality
• Best used in combination with other methods
• Performance varies with content type
